title: Ridgeline Installation Services Failed-Visit Trip Charge Amount
content:
**Amount.** The failed-visit trip charge is the program's trip charge for the installation program on the contract, rounded to the cent.

## Terms used

- **The installation program on the contract** is the Ridgeline Installation Services program named on the contract record; each contract carries the trip charge of its own program.
- **The program's trip charge** is that program's trip charge figure in the program table of visit charges.
- **Rounding.** The charge is a dollar amount rounded to the cent.

## Worked example (hypothetical program figures)

| Program trip charge | Failed-visit trip charge |
|---|---|
| 149.00 | 149.00 |
| 89.00 | 89.00 |

## Basis questions answered

**Is the trip charge the same on every program?** No. Each program has its own trip charge figure, and the charge follows the program on the contract.

**Is the trip charge a payment?** It is a charge on the contract; it raises the balance due.
